description: Delete one message. Safe to call directly: the first call deletes nothing and returns a preview plus a confirm_token, and the deletion only happens when the call is repeated with that token. Use this two-step flow to let the user approve through the conversation rather than telling them to delete things by hand in Discord. Supports dry_run.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

dry_run.description: If true, nothing is changed: the result shows what this call would do.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

message_id.description: The message to delete: its ID or link.

name: delete_message
title: Delete message
